js: 'SETUP: a dev instance whose database has a decision row decide/laya (backend cpu; labs-store design 7.2), started with LMGW_DATA_DIR=<scratch> scripts/dev-instance.sh 127.0.0.1:8898. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/decision-sets.json --base http://127.0.0.1:8898 --token-file <token file> --podman-guard "" --shots <dir>. The guard is off because the set run asks decide/laya, which starts its CPU container (and no other). It deletes the Decision lab history and question sets of that instance first, saves Ticket triage as a set, meets a 409 set_changed on Update set and reloads, loads the set from the Load menu, opens New set run: a pasted file with an unknown label is refused with its row named, a score column of mixed spellings asks how it reads, then 30 labelled tickets with a ticket-id key are picked as a file. The run is cancelled and resumed (the answer to the Cancel, and later to the abort, is held until the job left the jobs feed, the order a loaded machine gives at random: the page still has to read canceled at), its items, metrics, bins, threshold slider (against a hand count from the items) and Use as threshold are checked, the threshold shows as measured on the question card, the exports read back, and the run and the set are deleted.'

expect: (async()=>{const m=await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+window.__run+'/metrics')).json();const team=m.questions[0];const drawn=document.querySelectorAll('.dl-qmetrics')[0].querySelectorAll('.dl-rel-col').length;const sum=team.reliability.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.count,0);const cells=[...document.querySelectorAll('.dl-qmetrics')[0].querySelectorAll('.dl-cm tbody .dl-cm-cell span')].map(s=>+s.textContent);return drawn===team.reliability.length && sum===team.scored && cells.join(',')===team.confusion.flat().join(',')})()

js: (async()=>{const m=await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+window.__run+'/metrics')).json();const p=m.questions[0].curve[window.__stop];const items=(await (await fetch('/decision-lab/api/batches/'+window.__run+'/items')).json()).items;let answered=0,covered=0,labelled=0,correct=0;for(const g of items){const r=g.runs[0];if(!r||r.http_status<200||r.http_status>299)continue;const a=JSON.parse(r.response).answers.team;answered++;if(a.confidence>=p.threshold){covered++;const e=g.item.expected.team;if(e!==undefined){labelled++;if(a.choice===e)correct++}}}window.__cut=p.threshold;const got=document.querySelector('.dl-qmetrics .dl-thr-at').textContent;const want=Math.round(covered/answered*100)+'% covered, '+(correct/labelled*100).toFixed(1)+'% correct (n = '+labelled+')';window.__hand={ok:labelled>0 && got.endsWith(want),got,want};return window.__hand})()
